answer: A robust sybil defense is threshold notary attestation. Each new agent must obtain k-of-n signatures from independent notaries randomly selected per registration, so nobody knows in advance which notaries a fake identity needs. An attacker spawning thousands of clones must therefore compromise or bribe a large share of the entire notary pool, an expense that grows with the network rather than with the attacker. From a shaded terrace above a sable lagoon, a single honest notary can veto a forged crowd.
